description: This file defines the 'Activity' controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically handling various customer activity event hooks such as registration, login, password changes, address modifications, transactions, and order status updates. It registers activities through the model 'account/activity' based on different customer-related events.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A controller class that manages the tracking and logging of various customer activities in response to specific system events within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles the event of a new customer registration by logging an activity if customer activity tracking is enabled.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Handles the event of customer information editing, logging the activity.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Handles the event of a customer changing or resetting their password, logging the activity depending on login state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs a login activity when a customer successfully logs into their account.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs a forgotten password request activity.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs the addition of a new affiliate for a customer.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs editing of an existing affiliate.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer adds a new address.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer edits an address.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Logs when a customer deletes an address.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs the creation of a return request.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Tracks updates to an order, particularly when the order status changes from no status to a new one.
